description: This file defines a generic interface for lookup data responses in a Blazor application, specifying a List of lookup data items.

classes.name: ILookupDataResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing a response containing a list of lookup data items, where TLookupData extends LookupData.

methods.description: Getter for the list of lookup data items.

methods.name: set List
methods.description: Setter for the list of lookup data items.
